allow_instructions: Read-only git (status, diff, log, show) and xcodebuild -showdestinations or -showsdks are fine.
xcodebuild test or build for the SceneShift scheme on an iOS Simulator destination is expected.
npm ci and npm run typecheck inside scripts/ are expected.
Fetching Apple RoomPlan, Swift language, SwiftPM, and Cursor SDK docs is expected.
block_instructions: Never print, commit, or paste CURSOR_API_KEY or scripts/.env.
Do not git push --force, amend published history, skip hooks, or rewrite git config.
Do not clone FastAPI templates, add CocoaPods or Carthage, or scaffold backend/ or frontend/.
Do not start the next numbered plan task until the user approves.
Do not invent CapturedRoom fixture JSON or commit USDZ binaries from airdroped-tests/.
Xcode MCP write or delete tools (XcodeWrite, XcodeUpdate, XcodeRM, XcodeMV) should ask first.
Do not change DEVELOPMENT_TEAM, bundle id, or code signing unless the user asked.
